row.Finding: DuraPro PA6 CF offers notably higher impact resistance than DuraPro PA12 CF, including no-break performance in unnotched testing. However, it absorbs significantly more moisture (9% vs. 1.6% at saturation), meaning it requires more careful storage and drying to maintain performance. DuraPro PA6 CF is also not electrically insulating, unlike DuraPro PA12, due to its carbon fiber content.
